rationale: Build on the recurrent-tail baseline by reallocating scarce fp16 keep budget toward tail attention V-path tensors, while trimming default proj float retention and narrowing EMA tracking to tail-sensitive/export-critical tensors. The hypothesis is that final int8+zlib exact eval is more sensitive to recurrent-tail value transport and less helped by smoothing earlier or non-tail float-kept weights, so this spends bytes and endgame averaging where the winning reverse-tail path should care most.
title: Tail V-Path FP16 Reallocation With Tail-Focused EMA
